text: Alimentos Centenario, the Uruguayan food company behind the Centenario brand, is family-run: it has been managed by the same family since its founding in 1959.
short: Alimentos Centenario is run by the founding family

source.name: Alimentos Centenario official site: Nuestra empresa
source.quote: Centenario es una empresa familiar, manejada desde su inicio por la misma familia.
source.note: English: 'Centenario is a family company, run by the same family since its beginnings.' Undated company page; the date given is the day it was opened. The same page states the company was founded in 1959 and is in its third generation of the same family.
